prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If the object is approached and visible, then grab and check properties, move to location and do task, otherwise approach or scan surroundings.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Action ID = ScanSurroundings    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = DoSpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO MoveToLocation
		DO DoSpecificTask
	END
